title: Pollock, cabbage and barley pot with dill

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain kitchen staple, and vegetable stock counts as acceptable stock.

supermarket.reason: Pollock, pearl barley, white cabbage and crème fraîche are all everyday supermarket items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and simple simmering and steaming.

works.reason: 250g barley in 1.2 litres of stock for about 40 minutes, with fish steamed on shredded cabbage, gives a sensibly sized and seasoned pot for four.

honest_times.reason: Chopping an onion, dicing three carrots, shredding half a cabbage and chopping dill fits the 20 minutes of prep, and the steps add up to roughly the 45 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Half a white cabbage is cooked through the barley as a main component, and a warm one-pot suits a September evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, wholegrain barley and plenty of vegetables make a filling, balanced family dinner.
